finding: The new headline 'outsourced management (A3) is cheapest at every product count' under non-reliance (and in the base case at N≤2) rests on an asymmetry. A3 carries no cost for the registers, validator and enforced release gates. These are mandated regardless of the alternative chosen: owner decisions 6 and 7, BR-SDL-001 (P0, before-production) and BR-GOV-001. A4 carries them as ACT-026/027/028 (240–620 h build plus 60–160 h a year, about USD 54–250k over five years at N=1, midpoint about 150k). Adding them to A3 exceeds A3's advantage at every N: S4 gaps are USD 41k at N=1, 80k at N=5 and 177k at N=15. A3 therefore stops being cheapest. Conversely, if the model is right as written, C005 and ODP-09 recommend A4 over an option the model shows to win on cash, owner hours and independence, with no stated reason. Either way the economic conclusion put to the owner is wrong or unexplained. This is the R1-012/R3-035 defect recurring in another place.
